<h1>pw</h1>

[`{pw}` lets you test your `{golem}` and `{shiny}` applications with Playwright.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

The goal of `{pw}` is to bring end-to-end browser testing to your `{shiny}` applications by providing a set of tools to test your `{golem}` apps with Playwright.
